abstract: During cell division, faithful chromosome segregation is ensured by the mitotic spindle. van Toorn et al.1 uncovered that Cdk1-mediated phosphorylation of the dynein-activating adaptor NuMA promotes the timely assembly of dynein/dynactin/NuMA complexes, essential for correct mitotic progression and genome integrity.
